title: 2023 Panini Prizm #354 Tuli Tuipulotu Los Angeles Chargers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
Get your hands on this 2023 Panini Prizm trading card featuring Tuli Tuipulotu, a promising rookie from the Los Angeles Chargers. This card is made of high-quality card stock and has a standard size that is perfect for any collection. 

As an original and licensed product from Panini, this card is a must-have for any football fan. The card is not autographed, but it does come with a Prizm parallel/variety that adds a unique touch to the design. The card number is 354 and it belongs to the 2023 season of the National Football League (NFL). Don't miss out on the chance to own a piece of football history with this Tuli Tuipulotu Panini Prizm RC Rookie card.
